title: L2 reseed leaves global silo.stalk/roots = 0 (div-by-zero DoS / desync)
description: On L2 the Beanstalk Diamond is freshly initialized and farmer state is re-issued by the reseed init facets. ReseedSilo.reseedSiloDeposit sets per-account stalk (s.accts[account].stalk = accountStalk) and per-token global balances (s.sys.silo.balances[token].deposited/.depositedBdv), but it NEVER writes the protocol-wide accumulators s.sys.silo.stalk or s.sys.silo.roots. ReseedSun.init sets season/temperature/seedGauge and re-runs LibCases.setCasesV2 but does not touch silo.stalk/roots. InitReseed.init sets paused/isFarm/earnedBeans=0/season but not silo.stalk/roots. A full-repo search confirms s.sys.silo.stalk and s.sys.silo.roots are assigned ONLY by incremental production paths (LibSilo.mintActiveStalk/burnActiveStalk, LibGerminate, LibReceiving) and by mocks (MockSiloFacet.setStalkAndRoots) — never by any init/reseed contract. Therefore immediately after the L2 upgrade completes, accounts collectively hold millions of stalk (s.accts[].stalk > 0) while the globals are s.sys.silo.stalk == 0 and s.sys.silo.roots == 0. This breaks the core Silo invariant total stalk == sum(account stalk) and bricks the standard burn/transfer accounting.
impact: Two concrete consumer outcomes, both High: (1) DoS / division-by-zero. LibSilo.burnActiveStalk computes `roots = s.sys.silo.roots.mul(stalk).div(s.sys.silo.stalk)` and transferStalk computes `s.sys.silo.roots.sub(1).mul(stalk).div(s.sys.silo.stalk)`; with silo.stalk == 0 these revert (div by zero) the first time any migrated farmer withdraws, transfers stalk, plants, or converts — a broad post-migration freeze of withdrawals/transfers. (2) Accounting desync / mis-scaled rewards. mintActiveStalk takes its `roots==0` branch (roots = stalk * rootsBase) so the first depositor after migration mints roots against a global stalk that does not include the millions of already-issued account stalk; the global stalk/roots ratio is anchored to a single new deposit, so subsequent root issuance and burnActiveStalk proportions are computed against a total stalk far smaller than the true sum of account stalk. Earned-Bean distribution (LibSilo._balanceOfEarnedBeans uses silo.stalk*accountRoots/silo.roots) and LibGauge.getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv (silo.stalk/totalBdv) are mis-scaled. The migration upgrade thus either freezes core Silo operations or corrupts protocol-wide stalk/root accounting depending on which path executes first.

ite.intent: After the L1->L2 reseed, global silo.stalk/roots must equal the sum of all re-issued account stalk/roots so silo accounting stays consistent
ite.technique: Reseed writes per-account stalk and per-token deposited balances but omits the protocol-wide silo.stalk/silo.roots writes; globals remain at their zero default
ite.evasion: No attacker required — the defect is baked into the migration upgrade; it self-triggers on the first post-migration silo mutation by any honest farmer

ice_chain.corrupted_state: s.sys.silo.stalk == 0 and s.sys.silo.roots == 0 while s.accts[].stalk > 0 (global accumulators uninitialized post-reseed)
ice_chain.impact: Division-by-zero DoS of withdraw/transfer/plant, or mis-scaled global stalk/root accounting and earned-Bean distribution
ice_chain.consumer_function: LibSilo.burnActiveStalk / transferStalk / mintActiveStalk and LibSilo._balanceOfEarnedBeans, LibGauge.getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv
ice_chain.exploit_path: Reseed completes with silo.stalk=silo.roots=0 -> migrated farmer calls withdraw -> burnActiveStalk divides by silo.stalk(0) -> revert; or new deposit anchors globals excluding issued account stalk -> all subsequent ratios corrupted
